documents.title: CIS to Data Lakehouse — Billing Ingestion Specification
documents.description: Physical interface specification for the nightly batch extraction of billing event data from Oracle CC&B (CIS) to the Databricks Data Lakehouse bronze layer, orchestrated by Oracle Integration Cloud.
documents.scope: ADR-013 Phase 1 — Operational Analytics data ingestion
documents.overview: Nightly batch extraction of billing delta records from Oracle CC&B via Oracle Integration Cloud. OIC runs the CC&B batch extract adapter at 01:00 UTC, producing Avro-encoded billing event files that are written to the Databricks Lakehouse DBFS bronze path. The Avro schema is registered in the Confluent Schema Registry for governance and evolution management.

endpoints.description: OIC trigger endpoint — initiates a CC&B batch extract job for the specified date range. Returns a job_id for status polling.
Poll the status of a running extract job. Returns: pending | running | complete | failed.
Retrieve the list of Avro output files produced by a completed extract job.

documents.data-model:
Avro schema: fedc.cis.billing.BillingEvent (v2)

{
  "type": "record",
  "name": "BillingEvent",
  "namespace": "fedc.cis.billing",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "event_id",        "type": "string" },
    { "name": "account_id",      "type": "string" },
    { "name": "customer_id",     "type": "string" },
    { "name": "bill_date",       "type": { "type": "int", "logicalType": "date" } },
    { "name": "due_date",        "type": { "type": "int", "logicalType": "date" } },
    { "name": "amount_due",      "type": { "type": "bytes", "logicalType": "decimal", "precision": 10, "scale": 2 } },
    { "name": "amount_paid",     "type": ["null", { "type": "bytes", "logicalType": "decimal", "precision": 10, "scale": 2 }], "default": null },
    { "name": "bill_status",     "type": { "type": "enum", "name": "BillStatus", "symbols": ["ISSUED", "PAID", "OVERDUE", "CANCELLED"] } },
    { "name": "tariff_code",     "type": "string" },
    { "name": "meter_id",        "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null },
    { "name": "consumption_kwh", "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null },
    { "name": "extracted_at",    "type": { "type": "long", "logicalType": "timestamp-millis" } }
  ]
}
documents.error-handling:
OIC implements a three-tier error strategy:

1. Transient errors (network timeout, CC&B API 503): OIC retries the failed step up to 3 times with exponential backoff (30s, 60s, 120s).
2. CC&B extract job failure: OIC raises an alert to the Data Engineering on-call channel (ServiceNow event); next night's run will include the previous day's delta.
3. Avro schema validation failure: Files that fail schema validation are quarantined to bronze/cis/billing/_quarantine/ with an error manifest. Data Engineering reviews and either re-processes or raises a CC&B schema change ticket.

test-scenarios.description: Full extract: 500k billing records extracted and landed in Databricks DBFS bronze layer within the 2-hour SLA window (01:00–03:00 UTC).
test-scenarios.expected-outcome: All records present in bronze/cis/billing/YYYY-MM-DD/ with Avro schema conformance. No quarantine files generated.

test-scenarios.description: Transient failure recovery: OIC extract job fails on first attempt due to simulated CC&B timeout.
test-scenarios.expected-outcome: OIC retries after 30s. Second attempt succeeds. No manual intervention required. Alert raised on first failure and cleared on success.

test-scenarios.description: Schema evolution: CC&B adds an optional new field (payment_method) not in current Avro schema.
test-scenarios.expected-outcome: Avro schema backward-compatible evolution accepted by schema registry. Existing consumers unaffected. New field available in next Databricks silver refresh.

documents.title: CRM to CIS — Customer Account Sync Specification
documents.description: Physical interface specification for real-time bidirectional synchronisation of customer account data between Salesforce CRM and Oracle CC&B, orchestrated via Oracle Integration Cloud.
documents.scope: Customer Experience Programme — CRM Integration Phase 1
documents.overview: Bidirectional real-time synchronisation between Salesforce CRM (Account/Contact) and Oracle CC&B (Person/Account) via Oracle Integration Cloud. Salesforce Platform Events trigger OIC on account create/update. OIC transforms and routes to CC&B REST API. MDM golden record matching is applied to prevent duplicate person records. The reverse direction (CC&B → CRM) is triggered by CC&B account status changes.

endpoints.description: Salesforce REST API — create a new Account record. Used by the CC&B → CRM sync direction.
Salesforce REST API — update an existing Account (address, phone, status changes from CC&B).
CC&B REST API — create a new Person + Account from CRM data. Returns account_id.
CC&B REST API — update an existing customer account (address, contact details).

documents.data-model:
CRM Account → CC&B Person mapping (OIC transformation):

Salesforce Account         CC&B Person/Account
─────────────────────      ────────────────────────
Id                    →    external_crm_id
Name                  →    person.name (split: first/last)
BillingStreet         →    address.line1
BillingCity           →    address.city
BillingPostalCode     →    address.postcode
Phone                 →    contact.phone
Email                 →    contact.email
Account_Status__c     →    account.status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE)
External_ID__c        ←    account.account_id (written back)
documents.error-handling:
OIC error handling for CRM→CIS direction:
- HTTP 4xx from CC&B (validation error): OIC posts a failed event to Salesforce Platform Event (Account_Sync_Error__e) with error detail. Salesforce workflow alerts the CRM admin.
- HTTP 5xx from CC&B: OIC retries up to 3 times (15s interval). On persistent failure, event lands in OIC error queue for manual replay.
- MDM duplicate detected: OIC resolves via golden record match and links to existing CC&B account. No new account created. Logged in OIC audit trail.

test-scenarios.description: New customer created in Salesforce CRM — account provisioned in CC&B within 30 seconds.
test-scenarios.expected-outcome: CC&B Person + Account created. Salesforce External_ID__c updated with new account_id. No duplicate in MDM.

test-scenarios.description: Customer address updated in CC&B — Salesforce Account billing address updated within 60 seconds.
test-scenarios.expected-outcome: Salesforce BillingStreet, BillingCity, BillingPostalCode match CC&B updated values.

test-scenarios.description: Concurrent create: same customer created in CRM and CC&B simultaneously before integration is active.
test-scenarios.expected-outcome: MDM match detects duplicate. OIC links both records to single golden record. No duplicate Person in CC&B. Alert raised for data steward review.
